prompt: It's Sunday morning. Give me my weekly metrics review. We have 35 registered users, 12 Pro subscribers, 0 Business subscribers. 1 user churned this week (payment failure). 2 new Sentry errors. Uptime was 99.8%.

assertions.text: Flags churn rate as red (1/12 or ~1/13 = >5% threshold)
Uses the Sunday Metrics Template format with traffic lights
References Phase 1 MRR target (₱6K-₱10K) and shows gap
Includes a top priority and notes for Monday standup
